name: AD — NTLM Authentication Fan-Out
description: A single source IP used NTLM to authenticate (network logon type 3) to 8 or more distinct hosts within 6 hours — the fan-out signature of Pass-the-Hash or credential replay spreading across the estate. The rule aggregates 4624 NTLM logons per source.ip and counts distinct destination hosts and identities. Attackers replay a stolen NTLM hash from one foothold to reach many machines quickly. Maps to ATT&CK Lateral Movement T1550.002 (Pass the Hash) with T1021.002 (SMB/Windows Admin Shares).
note:
### Investigation
1. Review dest_hosts and accounts — one identity spraying many hosts, or many identities from one source (both suspicious)?
2. Determine whether source.ip is a sanctioned mgmt/patch/EDR/PAM node (known_infrastructure) that legitimately reaches many endpoints.
3. Pivot on the accounts used and check whether NTLM (not Kerberos) is expected for those hosts — NTLM where Kerberos is normal strengthens PtH.
4. Correlate follow-on 5140/5145 admin-share access and any 4672 on the destinations.
5. Escalate if the source is not an inventoried management host and the accounts are privileged.

### False positives / benign
Management, patch (SCCM), EDR, and PAM push hosts legitimately fan out NTLM to many endpoints — the baseline names mgmt 10.11.18.21/.49 and PAM 10.11.102.15 reaching 13-18 hosts. Distinguish by resolving source.ip against a known_infrastructure management group and by identity profile: sanctioned tooling uses a stable service account to a predictable host set, whereas PtH shows a user/admin credential reaching an unusual or growing set. Baseline the known pushers rather than raising the threshold, which would let a slow attacker under it.
author: raadabujaish
false_positives: Management/patch/EDR servers and PAM that legitimately push to many endpoints via NTLM (validate then suppress by source.ip).
query:
FROM logs-system.security-*
| WHERE event.code == "4624" AND winlog.event_data.LogonType == "3" AND winlog.event_data.AuthenticationPackageName == "NTLM" AND source.ip IS NOT NULL AND source.ip != "::1"
| STATS ntlm_logons=COUNT(*), dest_hosts=COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name), identities=COUNT_DISTINCT(winlog.event_data.TargetUserName), accounts=VALUES(winlog.event_data.TargetUserName), first_seen=MIN(@timestamp), last_seen=MAX(@timestamp) BY source.ip
| WHERE dest_hosts >= 8
| SORT dest_hosts DESC
